The same client, with proper preparation, returned six months later for Techtextil and booked 47 meetings before the show even opened. Preparation is the difference between a EUR 45,000 expense and a EUR 45,000 investment.

blocks.inner: A trade show is not a larger version of a sales meeting. It is a compressed, high-intensity environment where you manage space design, logistics, staff performance, lead capture, and brand perception — all simultaneously, in a venue you do not control, under rules you did not write.

blocks.translated: Bir ticari fuar, bir satış toplantısının büyük hali değildir. Aynı anda ziyaretçi eleme, ürün demosu, marka sunumu ve rekabet analizi yaptığınız sıkıştırılmış, yüksek yoğunluklu bir ortamdır.

blocks.inner: First-time exhibitors face challenges that repeat exhibitors have already solved: understanding the exhibitor manual (often 80-120 pages of technical regulations), navigating union rules at venues like Messe Frankfurt or DWTC, budgeting for hidden costs that do not appear in the initial space contract, and building a stand that attracts visitors in a hall with 500+ competitors.

blocks.translated: İlk kez katılanlar, tekrarlayan katılımcıların çoktan çözdüğü zorluklarla karşılaşır: katılımcı el kitabını anlamak (genellikle 80-120 sayfalık teknik düzenleme), DWTC Dubai gibi mekanlarda sendika kurallarında gezinmek, hangi hizmetlerin stand üreticisine hangilerinin mekana ait olduğunu ayırt etmek ve gerçekten işe yarayan bir müşteri adayı yakalama süreci oluşturmak.

blocks.inner: The exhibitor manual is your single most important document. It contains everything: stand construction deadlines, permitted materials, ceiling height limits, suspension point load capacities, electrical regulations, fire certification requirements, waste disposal rules, and penalty clauses. Exhibitors who read it 4 weeks before the fair avoid the mistakes that cost others EUR 2,000-8,000 in on-site corrections.

blocks.translated: Katılımcı el kitabı en önemli belgenizdir. Stand inşaatı teslim tarihlerinden izin verilen malzemelere, tavan yüksekliği sınırlarından asma noktası yük kapasitelerine, elektrik sipariş formlarından teslimat zaman aralıklarına kadar her şeyi içerir. Her mekanın kendine özgü versiyonu vardır. Son başvuru tarihinden sonra yapılan değişiklikler genellikle %25-50 ek ücrete tabidir.

blocks.inner: Your stand builder should know the manual for your specific venue. If they have never built at Messe Düsseldorf, they will not know about the Brandwache requirement. If they have never worked at Dubai World Trade Centre, they will underestimate the visa and customs timeline. Venue-specific experience is not a nice-to-have — it directly affects your budget and schedule.

Evaluate each event on four criteria: visitor profile match (are the attendees your actual buyers?), geographic relevance (does the show serve your target market?), exhibitor list quality (who else is exhibiting — competitors or complementary brands?), and cost-to-reach ratio (total budget divided by estimated qualified visitors at your stand).

This goal determines every decision that follows.
